title: Strings Differ by One Character
summary: Given a list of strings of equal length, determine if any two strings differ by exactly one character at the same position.
statement: Given a list of strings of equal length, determine if any two strings differ by exactly one character at the same position.
constraints: All words have equal length and are distinct.
Return true if two different words differ at exactly one position.
hints: Replace one position at a time by a marker to form a deletion-position pattern.
Two distinct words share a pattern exactly when they agree everywhere except that marked position.
Return when a pattern was seen from an earlier word.
Including the marker position prevents deletions at different indices from colliding.
editorial: Including the marker position prevents deletions at different indices from colliding.

tests.explanation: Words abcd and aacd differ only at their second character.
Every pair differs at both positions, so the answer is false.
